adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, when a referenced `credentialId` isn’t found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, the new fallback fetches it via `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` and then assigns the raw Prisma credential record to `calendarCredential`, which is passed to `getCalendar(calendarCredential)`. Unlike the parallel fallback added in `EventManager.ts` (which explicitly `include`s `app.slug` and synthesizes a `CredentialWithAppName` with `appName: credentialFromDB.app.slug`), this fallback provides no `appName` (and no `app` relation). Given the diff shows other new logic needing `appName` to resolve the calendar integration, this makes `getCalendar(...)` plausibly return `null/undefined`, causing `calendar?.deleteEvent(...)` to no-op and pushing `undefined` into `apiDeletes` without surfacing an error—so referenced hosts’ calendar events may not be deleted during cancellation.
